source_contract: All spans are vexel_xml::XmlSpan offsets into immutable source bytes. CssSheet borrows and retains the source and matching token slice supplied at creation; compute takes only an element index and optional parent paint. CssValue/CssPaint borrow values from the sheet source. Parent paints with a different source slice identity are rejected by pointer/length identity without cloning source bytes.

scope_adaptations: Rust ownership replaces the nullable opaque sheet and explicit destroy function; source and value spans remain borrowed.
compute no longer accepts source or tokens; CssSheet retains its create-time source and tokens, preventing per-call source/token substitution without a copy.
